title: eXtra Live Collect them all
description: This is a modpack for a Minecraft project within the eXtra Live community. It mainly focuses on the Collect Everything mod, along with some quality of life (QoL) mods.
body:
This is a modpack for a Minecraft project within the eXtra Live community. It mainly focuses on the Collect Everything mod, along with some quality of life (QoL) mods.

The main goal of the project is to collect every possible item and achievement. Other mods won't change the vanilla experience too far. Just some performance mods and QoL mods like Inventory sorting. Also, it already contains Shared Backpack. That way you can work even better with your friends together. In the near future there will be some more additions like Waystones for easy travelling or a Tombstone mod for a less frustrating experience. Keep an eye on the version changelog ;)

If you ever wanted to collect everything in Minecraft, this modpack could be of interest to you.

The modpack will be extended as wished by the eXtra Live community and as more progress is made in the Collect Everything mod.

We're playing on a whitelisted server, and only trusted members of the community are allowed to play. While the modpack can be played in singleplayer, it's highly recommended to play with your friends ;)
